question: In ΔPQR, ∠Q = 66° and ∠R = 34°. T is a point on QR , and S is a point between Q and T such that PS ⊥ QR and PT is the bisector of ∠QPR. What is the measure of ∠SPT?
solution:
**Given:**

PS ⊥ QR

∠Q = 66° and ∠R = 34°

PT is the bisector of ∠QPR

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/635fd8edbaa3e86aed5907cc464d684940975e0a792ef720a4a96bd88e6be94c.png] 

∠QPR = 180° - 66° - 34°

⇒ 80°

∠QPT = ∠TPR = 40° [As PT angle bisector]

In Δ PTR

∠PTR + ∠PRT + ∠TPR = 180° 

⇒ ∠PTR = 180° - 34° - 40°

⇒ ∠PTR = 106°

Now,

∠PTS + ∠PTR = 180°

⇒ ∠PTS + 106° = 180°

⇒ ∠PTS = 180° - 106°

⇒ ∠PTS = 74°

So,

∠SPT = 180° - 90° - 74°

⇒ ∠SPT = 16°

**∴ The measure of ∠SPT is 16°.**
